features: Key Applications: Virtualization, Software-defined Storage, AI Inference and Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Enterprise Server, High-Performance Computing (HPC)
Dual Socket AMD EPYC™ 9006 SP7 Series Processors up to 512 Cores
